name: Zipper valves (one per well branch)
function: The hydraulic gate valve in each well branch that selects which well the spread treats; open on the well being fractured, closed on the wells being prepared for wireline.

tabs.overview: Each branch has at least one hydraulic valve; many manifolds fit two in series for double isolation of a well with wireline in the hole. Valves are cycled once per stage per well, which makes them the highest-cycle valves on the pad.
tabs.engineering: Same API 6A hydraulic gate valve as the tree; position indicated at the control panel.
tabs.safety: A branch to a well with a lubricator on the tree must be closed and verified before the neighbor is pumped; the position lamp is not the only check, the pressure on the closed branch is watched too.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Tree saver in the wellhead; valves fully open or fully closed only; iron inspection.

connections.note: Instance of the hydraulic gate valve variant
